subject: Console cost breakdown: copy for “estimated” + assumptions/confidence + support enablement
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Jada Williams <jada_williams@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Mar 1, 2025 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Console cost breakdown: copy for “estimated” + assumptions/confidence + support enablement

Team — we’re close on the Console cost breakdown page wiring to SCM, but we need to lock the user-facing language so we don’t create billing confusion.

Goals for copy:
1) Clearly label this as an estimate / technical attribution (NOT invoice).
2) Explain “assumptions” when telemetry is missing and how that affects confidence.
3) Give Support a short, consistent answer to the “why doesn’t this match my spend?” question.

Proposed UI strings (v3 attached):
- Page header: “Estimated inference cost”
- Subtitle: “Estimated using runtime signals (tokens, batching, caching) and hardware profiles. Not used for invoicing.”
- Confidence badge: High / Medium / Low, with tooltip.
- “Assumptions” section: only show when Medium/Low.

Open questions to resolve in this thread:
A) Do we use the word “estimate” or “modeled” anywhere? (I prefer “Estimated”)
B) What does the confidence badge actually mean (and what triggers Low)?
C) Support macro: 3–5 bullet response + link(s).

If we can align by Monday EOD, I’ll hand the final copy to Docs/Support enablement and unblock DES-221.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Console & Rollouts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Console_Cost_Breakdown_Copy_v3.docx


From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Jada Williams <jada_williams@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Mar 1, 2025 at 10:04 AM PT
Subject: Re: Console cost breakdown: copy for “estimated” + assumptions/confidence + support enablement

+1 to “Estimated” vs “Modeled.” “Modeled” reads like we’re making up numbers.

Two things we should be explicit about in the tooltip:
- SCM returns deterministic results for the same inputs, but inputs can be incomplete due to telemetry delay / aggregation.
- Some components are normalized (GPU SKU, region) and may not align to contract pricing.

Re confidence triggers: from platform side we can supply a simple reason set (missing_dimensions=[region, quant_profile_id], used_defaults=[batch_size_effective], telemetry_age_seconds, etc.). I’d rather avoid a complex score explanation in Console; keep it user-friendly.

Priya


From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Jada Williams <jada_williams@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Mar 1, 2025 at 11:18 AM PT
Subject: Re: Console cost breakdown: copy for “estimated” + assumptions/confidence + support enablement

From Optimize POV, “Estimated inference cost” matches how we’ll frame “what-if” scenarios, so consistent language helps.

I’d avoid “Not used for invoicing” as the only disclaimer. Customers read that as “then why should I trust it?” Suggest:
- “This estimate is intended for engineering optimization (batching/caching/quantization). Billing may differ due to pricing plans, discounts, and rounding.”

Support question we keep getting in POCs: “Why did my cost go UP when I enabled batching?”
We should add a one-liner about tradeoffs:
- “Batching changes latency/throughput; savings depend on request shape and cacheability.”

Aditya


From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Jada Williams <jada_williams@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Mar 1, 2025 at 12:02 PM PT
Subject: Re: Console cost breakdown: copy for “estimated” + assumptions/confidence + support enablement

Agree on “Estimated inference cost.”

On the disclaimer: we should explicitly say it’s “technical cost” (compute/memory/cache) rather than “price.” Customers map cost → bill.

Suggestion:
- Replace “Not used for invoicing.” with “Not a billing statement.”
- Add “Your invoice is based on your pricing plan and contract terms.”

Also: avoid “savings” wording on the page itself unless it’s in Optimize. Console should feel descriptive/auditable.

Laura


From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Jada Williams <jada_williams@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Mar 2, 2025 at 9:31 AM PT
Subject: Re: Console cost breakdown: copy for “estimated” + assumptions/confidence + support enablement

Engineering constraints we should account for in copy/UI:
- The confidence badge will be computed from SCM response fields (confidence_level + assumptions list). We can show the badge and a compact tooltip without dumping the raw fields.
- We need a short “empty state” when SCM is slow/unavailable (we’ve seen timeouts in staging).

Proposed error/empty state copy:
- Title: “Cost breakdown temporarily unavailable”
- Body: “We couldn’t load the estimate right now. This does not affect your traffic. Try again in a few minutes.”

Support enablement: can we keep the customer-visible tooltip minimal and put the detailed mapping (confidence → missing signals) in an internal help doc?

Chloe
Console Backend Lead


From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Jada Williams <jada_williams@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Mar 2, 2025 at 2:46 PM PT
Subject: Re: Console cost breakdown: copy for “estimated” + assumptions/confidence + support enablement

+1 on the empty state copy.

One more thing: if SCM is timing out, Console should degrade gracefully and not keep spamming retries. Please avoid language that suggests “refresh until it works.”

From an SRE perspective, customer-facing copy should not imply an SLA on this page (yet). “temporarily unavailable” is fine.

Sean
SLOs / On-call Owner

Date: Mon, Mar 3, 2025 at 9:08 AM PT
Subject: Re: Console cost breakdown: copy for “estimated” + assumptions/confidence + support enablement

Drafted Support FAQ (attached) based on the themes here. Key customer-facing answer (short form) is:

“Console shows an estimated technical cost breakdown (compute/memory/cache) based on runtime telemetry. It helps you understand cost drivers and evaluate optimizations. Your invoice is based on your pricing plan and contract terms, so totals may not match exactly.”

FAQ includes:
- Why it may differ from invoice (discounts, rounding, tiered pricing, credits, contract rates)
- Why it may change over time (model version, hardware SKU/region, batching/caching behavior)
- What ‘Low confidence’ means (missing or delayed telemetry; defaults applied)
- When to ask for an “explain” payload (internal only for now)

Marissa: once we lock the UI strings, I can align the wording in the FAQ and publish to the internal Support/CS space.

Attachment: Support_FAQ_SCM_Cost_Breakdown_v1.pdf


From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Jada Williams <jada_williams@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Mar 4, 2025 at 4:27 PM PT
Subject: Re: Console cost breakdown: copy for “estimated” + assumptions/confidence + support enablement

Decision summary (please reply only if you disagree):

1) Primary term: “Estimated inference cost” (NOT “modeled,” NOT “price”).
2) Subtitle/disclaimer (final):
   “An estimated technical cost breakdown based on runtime telemetry and hardware profiles. Not a billing statement.”
   Secondary line (smaller text): “Invoices are based on your pricing plan and contract terms.”
3) Confidence:
   - Badge: High / Medium / Low
   - Tooltip (customer-facing): “Confidence reflects completeness of telemetry used to compute this estimate.”
   - Only show “Assumptions” section when Medium/Low.
4) Assumptions section (customer-facing, short bullets):
   - “Some telemetry signals were missing or delayed.”
   - “Defaults were applied for one or more parameters.”
   - “Totals may change as more telemetry arrives.”
   (We’ll keep detailed reasons internal in Support FAQ / debug view.)
5) Empty/error state:
   “Cost breakdown temporarily unavailable… This does not affect your traffic.” (as Chloe suggested)

Next steps:
- Dylan/Chloe/Jada: please update the UI copy + tooltips accordingly for DES-221; I’ll comment on the ticket once this lands.
- Elliot: publish the Support FAQ with the final wording; include a short macro for “doesn’t match invoice.”
- Priya/Aditya: if we have a preferred internal link/identifier for the “explain” payload workflow, send it to Elliot to include.

Thanks all.

— Marissa
